name: geometry-tactical-ratio-thales-local
description: School-safe three-student local tactical geometry game with safe Level 1 deployment, fixed mission settings, live 5.00 scoring, large sine/cosine ratio and Thales proportion checkpoints, 120 Hz simulation, coordinated A* enemies, six weapons and automatic local JSON/CSV results.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare-professional-v50.js && node scripts/prepare-advanced-v51.js && node scripts/patch-advanced-v51-readiness.js && node scripts/prepare-ratio-thales-v52.js && npm run prepare:icons
scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v52/main.js && node --check school-game/v52/preload.js && node --check school-game/v52/game.js && node scripts/ratio-thales-v52-static-test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
